mapper.select: select Chuku_order.o_id,order_sort,o_state,o_date,keyboarder,p_name,p_number,o_receiver,o_address,o_recPhone, o_postcode,substation,o_invoice,remark,station from order_info_all, Chuku_order where order_info_all.o_id = Chuku_order.o_id =#{id}

select allocateid,first_classification,kufang_goods.cname,kufang_total.cnum,kufang_change.cnum diaobo_amount,kufang_goods.measure_unit,date from kufang_change,kufang_goods,kufang_total where kufang_change.cid=kufang_goods.cid=kufang_total.cid and allocateid=#{id}

select * from shangpin_diaobo
AND d_id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{diaobo_id},'%')
